researchQuestion: Does any current public official page state an actionable payment fee, convenience charge, or explicit zero fee for the primary property-tax-payment scenario?
answer: Yes, narrowly. The Bengaluru City Corporations refund policy states that the City Corporation does not charge or retain an additional service fee beyond the applicable statutory property-tax amount. The same sentence preserves a material limitation: bank or payment-gateway charges may exist, but the reviewed official public routes give no amount or actionable schedule for those charges.

newSources.title: Refund and Cancellation Policy - Bengaluru City Corporations Property Tax Online Payment Services
newSources.notes: The official two-page PDF is publicly accessible and displayed no publication or revision date. It identifies the covered service as online Property Tax payment through https://bbmptax.karnataka.gov.in. The displayed agency wording is recorded verbatim. HTTP status check returned 200 on 2026-09-06. Wayback Save Page Now was attempted for this exact PDF URL on 2026-09-06; the request timed out after 30 seconds with zero response bytes, so no snapshot URL was confirmed. The original official URL is retained, and archive capture remains unconfirmed.

newClaims.text: For online property-tax payment, the City Corporation does not charge or retain an additional service fee beyond the applicable statutory property-tax amount.
newClaims.notes: This is an explicit zero for a City Corporation-added service fee. It does not establish that the total transaction is free of bank or payment-gateway charges. The statutory property tax itself is outside the fee question.

newClaims.text: The official refund policy says bank or payment-gateway charges, if any, are non-refundable.
newClaims.notes: The policy supplies no amount, percentage, payment-mode matrix, or rule that lets a citizen determine whether a bank or gateway charge applies before payment. This claim is a limitation and does not independently support a stated cost value.

searchNotes.note: The HTML refund-policy route and matching official PDF state zero City Corporation-added service fees and preserve an unspecified bank/gateway-charge caveat. The terms and service-details routes describe supported payment modes and gateways but do not publish a fee amount, convenience-charge schedule, or broader zero-fee promise. No identifier was entered and no payment gateway was opened.
The Greater Bengaluru Authority public homepage links or refers to Property Tax but did not expose an actionable payment fee, convenience charge, or zero-fee statement in the reviewed public content.
